intent.name: FOREST SIGNAL // Bukidnon Awareness & Regeneration System
intent.description:
To design and deploy a Sovereign Awareness System that transforms satellite data, community memory, and AI analysis into actionable ecological intelligence, enabling users—especially local communities in Bukidnon—to:

Visually perceive forest loss and regeneration through layered mapping systems
Understand the environmental state of their land in real time
Generate awareness-driven content (maps, videos, narratives)
Activate small but meaningful ecological actions (planting, monitoring, sharing)
Core Intent

This system exists to bridge the gap between:

Invisible environmental degradation
and
Visible, actionable human awareness

By combining AI, geospatial data, and narrative synthesis, the system creates a living awareness loop:

Observe → Understand → Feel → Act → Share → Restore

System Principles
Truth-First Visualization
No exaggeration, only data-grounded representation
Satellite imagery as the source of ecological truth
Human-Centered Awareness
Designed for emotional resonance and cultural relevance
Honors local knowledge (e.g., Talaandig community practices)
Action-Oriented Output
Every insight leads to a suggested action
Awareness must translate into behavior
Layered Intelligence Architecture
Environmental data (RezFlow)
Narrative intelligence (SSE)
Deployment logic (SCE)
Cinematic output (TETRAFLUX)
Scalable Sovereignty
Works offline-first where possible
Can operate independently in local contexts
Community-driven growth model
Primary Features (System Capabilities)
1. 🌍 Visual Forest Mapping
Satellite-based land visualization (Google Earth / Sentinel)
Land classification:
Forest
Degraded
Recovering
Critical zones
Before/after and historical comparisons
2. 🧠 AI Environmental Analysis Engine
Detects:
Forest loss patterns
Regeneration potential
Soil and terrain suitability
Generates:
Ecological insights
Planting recommendations
Risk warnings
3. 🎬 Awareness Content Generator
Converts land data into:
Short-form videos (Reels / TikTok)
Awareness posters
Narrative scripts
Cinematic storytelling using TETRAFLUX:
Emotional hooks
Symbolic imagery
Time-based transitions
4. 🌱 Action Recommendation System
Context-aware actions:
“Plant native trees here”
“Join reforestation efforts”
“Monitor this area”
Supports:
Individual
Community
NGO-level actions
5. 🗺️ Interactive Awareness Map
Zoomable map interface
Layers:
Forest loss
Community activity
Reforestation zones
Clickable regions with:
Story
Data
Suggested actions
6. 🤝 Community Contribution Layer
Users can:
Upload photos
Log tree planting
Share local knowledge
Builds:
Collective ecological memory
Community-driven restoration tracking
Target Impact
Increase environmental awareness in Bukidnon and similar regions
Support reforestation and permaculture initiatives
Empower local communities with actionable intelligence
Transform passive observers into active ecological participants
Success Definition

The system succeeds when:

Users can clearly see forest loss and recovery
Awareness content leads to real-world planting and action
Communities begin to self-organize around ecological restoration
The land shows measurable regeneration over time
Execution Philosophy

“Do not build a platform.
Build a system that restores perception.
Because when people see clearly, they act.”

augmentation.architectureTemplate: Next.js 14 App Router + Server Actions + Zustand + Framer Motion + Web Workers

architecture.reason: Provides robust server-side rendering, streaming for heavy geospatial data, and seamless server actions for data mutations without excessive API boilerplate.

stateManagement.reason: Minimalist, unopinionated global state ideal for tracking continuous intent (drift_lock) across the application without the cognitive overhead of Redux.

styling.reason: Tailwind ensures strict, token-based adherence to the requested Sovereign Aesthetic palette. Framer Motion drives the TETRAFLUX cinematic UI behavior and deterministic transitions.

backend.reason: Essential for high-performance spatial querying, tracking reforestation polygons, and real-time offline-first synchronization for local communities.

teaching: Sovereign UI Design: Treat the user interface not as a web page, but as a telemetry dashboard. Every border and color must convey actionable ecological data.

Drift Lock State: The 'drift_lock' mechanism ensures that user intent (such as focusing on a specific geographic coordinate) persists predictably across route navigations, bypassing React's standard component unmount amnesia.
Deterministic Motion: Animations are mathematically tied to state intensity rather than arbitrary durations. High urgency data tightens animation curves, enforcing an immediate, unignorable reality.

warnings.message: Rendering high-resolution GeoJSON map layers can block the main thread.
warnings.suggestion: Offload vector tile calculations to a Web Worker (e.g., geoProcessor.worker.ts) and render using WebGL or Canvas rather than standard DOM elements.

warnings.message: Zustand's persisted state might disagree with the initial server-rendered HTML.
warnings.suggestion: Implement a custom hook to delay the application of persisted state until after the component has mounted on the client.

warnings.message: Remote communities in Bukidnon will have unreliable internet access.
warnings.suggestion: Implement Service Workers and IndexedDB immediately to allow offline action-logging, pushing updates only when telemetry connects to the network.

workers.name: GeoProcessor
workers.purpose: Parses large-scale Sentinel satellite metadata arrays and calculates forest-loss density heatmaps without locking the UI thread.

workers.name: TETRAFLUX Engine
workers.purpose: Asynchronously compiles geographic bounds, localized narratives, and telemetry into deployable short-form video instruction sets.
